75-24-03A.t: Low Pressure Turbine Active Clearance Control (LPTACC) Valve
75-24-03A.pt: Low Pressure Turbine Active Clearance Control (LPTACC) Valve
75-24-03A.txt:
Repair interval                    Nbr installed                    Nbr required                Placard
                  A                                  2                                0                       Yes
    (o) (m) One or both may be inoperative for 10 flight cycles provided that:
            1) The affected LPTACC valve is deactivated in the closed position, and
            2) The associated engine takeoff EGT margin is above 5 °C.
             Note:      <After Door Closed> Return To Gate
             Note:      <MAINTENANCE>
                        1. Contact MCC for Defer Control.

                                                       Reference(s)
        (o) Refer to OpsProc 75-24-03A LPTACC Valve
        (m) Refer to AMM Task 75-22-00-040-801
75-24-03A.ko:
(o) (m) 다음 조건이면 하나 또는 둘 다 10 flight cycles(비행 횟수) 동안 작동 불능 상태로 운항할 수 있다:
1) 해당 LPTACC valve를 닫힌 위치(closed position)로 비활성화(deactivate)하고,
2) 해당 엔진의 이륙 EGT margin이 5 °C를 초과한다.
Note: <도어 닫힌 후 발생 시> Return To Gate (게이트로 돌아가 정비 조치 필요)
Note: <MAINTENANCE (정비 조치)>
1. Defer Control(이연 관리)은 MCC에 연락.

75-24-03A.t: Low Pressure Turbine Active Clearance Control (LPTACC) Valve
75-24-03A.txt:
FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS
     Flight planning:
         Increase fuel consumption by 1.5 %.
  FLIGHT CREW
     Contact dispatcher for flight release update and “FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS”
     confirmation.
  GENERAL INFORMATION
      After application of the maintenance procedure:
       The ENG FADEC MAINTENANCE message may be displayed on the STATUS SD page.
  DURING COCKPIT PREPARATION
     Check that the remaining EGT margin at Maximum Takeoff Thrust (MTO) provided by the Engine
     Condition Monitoring Tool is above 5 °C.
     Note:      • The result provided by the Engine Condition Monitoring Tool must not be older than
                  one month.
                • A new EGT margin assessment must be performed in the case of engine malfunction
                  or engine related external event such as a bird strike.
75-24-03A.ko:
FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS (비행계획 제한)
비행계획(Flight planning):
연료 소모량을 1.5 % 증가시킨다.
FLIGHT CREW (운항승무원 조치)
운항관리사(dispatcher)에게 연락하여 flight release 갱신과 “FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS” 확인을 받는다.
GENERAL INFORMATION (일반 정보)
• 정비 절차 적용 후:
STATUS SD page에 ENG FADEC MAINTENANCE 메시지가 표시될 수 있다.
DURING COCKPIT PREPARATION (조종실 준비 중)
Engine Condition Monitoring Tool이 제공하는 Maximum Takeoff Thrust(MTO)에서의 잔여 EGT margin이 5 °C를 초과하는지 확인한다.
Note: • Engine Condition Monitoring Tool이 제공한 결과는 1개월 이내의 것이어야 한다(1개월보다 오래된 결과는 사용 불가).
• 엔진 고장이나 bird strike 같은 엔진 관련 외부 사건이 있었던 경우에는 EGT margin을 새로 평가해야 한다.
